name: Have I Been Pwned API
description: The Have I Been Pwned (HIBP) API provides access to data breach information, paste data, and pwned password checks. It allows querying whether an email address or domain has been compromised in known data breaches, checking passwords against a database of previously exposed credentials, and retrieving stealer log information.
